provenance.interpretation: Best-guess dated scene constrained by historical beach, unit and vessel assignments. Geometry and between-anchor movement are synthetic, with per-feature sources and uncertainty.
provenance.source_geometry_policy: Source chart fixes and authored estimates are distinguished per feature; estimated points must not be rendered as exact tracks.
provenance.modern_reference: Natural Earth coastline is used only as a present-day projection reference; it is not evidence of the 1944 tide line, obstacles, or beach edge.
provenance.political_context: No political-border geometry is included in this first slice: the verified source set does not provide a bounded, dated border shape suitable for this scene.
